data.description:
## Context / Problem
Bugs are exempt from the claim-time plan-review gate (correct: no RCA exists at claim). But the exemption short-circuits EXPLICIT 'review-plan <bug>' to a hollow exempt-PASS (claimability.py), so complex fixes never get plan review before landing — fixes shipping design changes (backtest: 13/113 bug-fix commits exceeded 150 non-test lines; all 13 adjudicated substantive, two shipped ADRs) flow to main unreviewed.

## Approach
B1: narrow the exemption to the claim-gate path only — explicit 'review-plan <bug>' runs a REAL review of the fix plan written into the description post-RCA. B2: DET code-review criterion at Gerrit: commit trailer ticket is type=bug AND non-test diff >150 lines AND plan_review_status verdict NOT IN {certified, stale-code, stale-head} -> BLOCKING finding teaching remediation (write fix plan into description -> review-plan -> re-push). stale-code/stale-head are ACCEPTED (code drift from implementing the reviewed plan is expected); only unsigned/stale-material/stale-reopened flag — this prevents the attestation being invalidated by the fix change itself. plan_review_status (attest_gate.py) is read-only/no-LLM, callable from the review-bot checkout. Works for non-skill clients (keys only on ticket type + diff size + attestation state).

## Scope
- src/rebar/llm/plan_review/claimability.py (exemption narrowing)
- review-bot DET criterion (vote pipeline)
- rebar-debug skill Phase-1-exit hook: fix-plan-to-description + review-plan for non-trivial fixes (coordinate with the debug-skill child)

## Testing
B1: review-plan on a bug with a fix-plan description runs the full review (not exempt-PASS); claim path unchanged (bug claims stay ungated). B2 unit tests over the predicate: bug+160 non-test lines+unsigned -> BLOCK; same with certified or stale-code -> no finding; task ticket -> no finding; bug+40 lines -> no finding.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Explicit review-plan <bug> executes a real review; claim-time exemption intact.
- [ ] Gerrit DET criterion blocks oversized bug fixes lacking a current-or-code-drifted attestation, with a teaching message.
- [ ] Verdict predicate accepts certified/stale-code/stale-head, flags unsigned/stale-material/stale-reopened (self-invalidation solved).
- [ ] Backtest property: threshold catches the 13 substantive historical fixes, zero mechanical FPs.
data.title: Bug-fix plan review: real review on explicit review-plan <bug> + Gerrit DET backstop for oversized fixes
